same_conditions.nonprecision_receiver_basis: Conservative project planning allowance per powered nonprecision input/divider branch, not a guaranteed OPA4196 limit. LM393B has a retained 50 nA full-temperature row at the table defaults VS=5 V and VCM=V-; that row is not an unconditional +/-12 V / AGND or +5 V input guarantee.

same_conditions.reference_envelope_basis: Planning +/-0.5% including master reference, inversion and local offset; not a guaranteed whole-chain accuracy.
